raw.rationale: Atorvastatin is a potent HMGCR inhibitor but in 5-day PRISM viability screens statins show only weak, non-lineage-selective cytotoxicity at low micromolar concentrations, with any selectivity typically linked to high LDLR/SLCO1B1 expression or HMGCR-addicted lineages such as liver and certain leukemias, none of which are among the listed lineages. Therefore selective killing probabilities are near the low baseline for all listed lineages.
